auth.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token, which is then used in the HTTP Authentication header for API requests.
Then click Copy API Key to Clipboard to copy your API key for use in integrations or API requests.
DealCloud MCP uses OAuth to authenticate, letting AI assistants connect on behalf of an individual user.

access.quote: If you do not see the Admin section, contact your organization's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager (CSM) for assistance.

api.quote: This site provides a comprehensive overview of our REST APIs, their capabilities, and available endpoints.
Each DealCloud site provides an interactive Swagger page for testing API calls.

mcp.quote: A compatible AI assistant connects to the DealCloud MCP Server and signs in as the user.
The default endpoint follows this format: https://[tenant].my.intapp.com/mcp/celeste/DealCloud
Custom / third-party AI clients — Contact your Account Manager

uncertain.auth_methods: REST auth is OAuth2 client_credentials where client_id + a per-user API key are exchanged for a 15-minute bearer token; there is no authorization-code flow for the REST API (the MCP server does use user OAuth). A grader may label primary as api_key.
uncertain.api_breadth: About 55-60 documented endpoints (data rows/cells, schema & metadata, user management, publications, backups, reports, relationship intelligence), many of them metadata. That is over the 50+ broad threshold, but the data API is generic (entry types), so 'moderate' is defensible.
uncertain.access: No public pricing, trial or developer sandbox found; access needs an existing DealCloud customer site or an Intapp partnership (Intapp has a 'Technology and integration partners' program). contact_sales vs partner_gated is a judgement call.

notes: MCP docs now describe write tools (submit_entry, validate_create_entry) behind an 'Enable Write Tools' toggle, contradicting third-party blog claims that the MCP is read-only. MCP tools mention a 'DealCloud GraphQL schema' (execute_query), but no public GraphQL API is documented for REST developers, so api_styles is rest only. Third-party AI clients for MCP require contacting the account manager.
